sectors.note:
**TL;DR:** Energy remains the undisputed market leader as the sole "all-green" sector, while Healthcare, Technology, and Financials make marginal gains against slipping cyclical groups.

US equity sectors are showing highly concentrated strength, with only 1 of 11 groups—Energy—achieving all-green status across weekly, monthly, quarterly, semi-annual, and YTD horizons. Energy dominates the board with a momentum score of 0.93, cementing its position as the top sustained performer. Meanwhile, heavyweight sectors like Healthcare (+1 spot, rank 4, momentum 0.75) and Technology (+1 spot, rank 2, momentum 0.72) are grinding higher, alongside Financials (+1 spot, rank 6, momentum 0.68).

Conversely, cyclical and interest-rate-sensitive sectors are losing ground. Basic Materials, Industrials, and Real Estate each slipped 1 spot over the last five sessions. Laggards remain deeply entrenched at the bottom, with Utilities (momentum 0.20) and Consumer Cyclical (momentum 0.22) exhibiting some of the weakest momentum in the market.

## Strength
* **Energy** is the sole "all-green" sector across all timeframes, boasting a dominant momentum score of 0.93 (Rank 1).
* Market breadth is extremely narrow, with only 1 out of 11 sectors exhibiting positive performance across the week, month, quarter, half, and YTD.
* **Healthcare** (momentum 0.75, rank 4) and **Technology** (momentum 0.72, rank 2) follow Energy as the next strongest momentum leaders.

## Movers & Momentum
* **Financials** (momentum 0.68), **Healthcare** (momentum 0.75), and **Technology** (momentum 0.72) were the only sectors to improve their rankings over the past 5 sessions, each rising by +1 spot.
* **Basic Materials** (rank 3), **Industrials** (rank 5), and **Real Estate** (rank 7) led the decliners, each dropping -1 spot over the same 5-day period.
* **Utilities** (momentum 0.20) and **Consumer Cyclical** (momentum 0.22) anchor the bottom of the momentum spectrum, showing persistent weakness.

## Divergences
* **Basic Materials** is actively fading; despite holding a solid momentum score of 0.68 and a YTD rank of 3, its rank slipped by -1 spot over the last 5 sessions.
* **Industrials** exhibits a notable divergence, holding a moderate YTD rank of 5 but suffering from a very weak momentum score of 0.22.

industries.note:
**TL;DR:** Energy and marine shipping dominate the market's top tier, while a sharp rotation into coal and agricultural inputs contrasts with a steep drop in uranium and travel-related services.

The US industry landscape on September 2, 2026, shows a highly concentrated pocket of strength, with only 13 of 144 groups achieving "all-green" status across all timeframes. Energy dominates this elite tier, led by Oil & Gas Refining & Marketing (momentum 0.983) and Oil & Gas Integrated (momentum 0.862). Marine Shipping (momentum 0.915) and Agricultural Inputs (momentum 0.859) also exhibit sustained leadership, while resources like Coking Coal (+22 spots, momentum 0.85) and Thermal Coal (+21 spots, momentum 0.70) are surging rapidly up the ranks.

Conversely, defensive and cyclical areas are experiencing a notable cool-down. Uranium has plummeted 28 spots (momentum 0.33), while travel and leisure-related groups like Lodging (-16 spots) and Travel Services (-15 spots) are fading fast. Early warning signs are also showing up in metals, with Gold (-11 spots) and Copper (-6 spots) slipping in rank despite holding decent momentum. Meanwhile, defensive laggards like Discount Stores (+13 spots, momentum 0.41) are beginning to emerge from low bases.

## Strength
* **Energy Dominance:** The energy sector secures multiple "all-green" spots, led by Oil & Gas Refining & Marketing (momentum 0.983, rank_ytd 2), Oil & Gas Integrated (momentum 0.862, rank_ytd 12), and Oil & Gas E&P (momentum 0.83).
* **Sustained Leaders:** Marine Shipping (momentum 0.915, rank_ytd 6) and Agricultural Inputs (momentum 0.859, rank_ytd 20) continue to show robust multi-month strength.
* **Defensive and Tech Anchors:** Health Information Services (momentum 0.85), Biotechnology, and Software - Application remain in the top tier of sustained performers.

## Movers & Momentum
* **Coal & Metals Surge:** Coking Coal jumped 22 spots to rank 40 (momentum 0.85), Thermal Coal gained 21 spots to rank 62 (momentum 0.70), and Aluminum rose 20 spots to rank 60 (momentum 0.56).
* **Severe Uranium & Travel Selloff:** Uranium fell 28 spots to rank 83 (momentum 0.33), while Lodging (-16 spots to rank 71) and Travel Services (-15 spots to rank 112) suffered sharp weekly declines.
* **Bottom Laggards:** Footwear & Accessories (momentum 0.073, rank_ytd 141) and Advertising Agencies (momentum 0.148, rank_ytd 144) remain anchored at the absolute bottom of the momentum rankings.

## Divergences
* **Fading Commodities & Services:** Gold (momentum 0.61, rank -11 in 5d) and Copper (momentum 0.68, rank -6 in 5d) are slipping in rank despite solid momentum, alongside Staffing & Employment Services (momentum 0.76, rank -6 in 5d).
* **Emerging Low-Momentum Groups:** Discount Stores (rank +13 in 5d, momentum 0.41) and Waste Management (rank +11 in 5d, momentum 0.49) are showing early signs of a turnaround from depressed levels.
* **Defensive Rotation:** Internet Content & Information (rank +6 in 5d, momentum 0.45) and REIT - Diversified (rank +5 in 5d, momentum 0.33) are quietly climbing the ranks.
